name: io.github.f-tiger/dollscout-collecting
title: The Doll Scout · Collecting Tools
description: Search collectible series, prepare checklists and event cards, calculate odds and display fit.

tools.name: labubu_rarity_odds
tools.description: Commonly reported secret/chase odds for Labubu / The Monsters blind-box series, by series format (6-figure, 12-figure, collabs, glow variants), with per-row sources. The box-printed odds for a specific series outrank every row returned here, and the result says so.

tools.name: labubu_fake_signals
tools.description: The eight authenticity checks for a Labubu figure (teeth count, face finish, box finish, anti-counterfeit seal, figure markings, build quality, price floor, seller of record), each with its named public sources. Compiled signals, not a guarantee; limitations are included.

tools.name: secret_pull_probability
tools.description: Probability of pulling at least one secret across N blind boxes at printed odds of 1-in-oddsN, plus the box counts a 50% and 90% chance require. Independent single-box model — sealed whole-case allocation can differ, and the result carries that caveat.

oddsN.description: The N in printed odds 1:N, e.g. 72

boxes.description: Number of blind boxes to be opened, e.g. 12

tools.name: define_labubu_term
tools.description: Plain-language definition of a Labubu / blind-box collecting term (blind box, series, regular, secret/chase, printed odds, case, glow variant, vinyl plush pendant, Lafufu, seller of record). Matches the term or its aliases; an unknown term returns the list of available terms, honestly.

term.description: The term to define, e.g. 'lafufu' or 'printed odds'

tools.name: calculate_style_probability
tools.description: Calculate independent-box chances for one regular style, a secret, or a user-supplied per-style probability. Required by mode: regular needs regularStyles and secretOddsN; secret needs secretOddsN; printed needs probabilityPercent. Regular mode assumes equally likely regular styles and replacement by a secret; not official series odds or sealed-case allocation.

tools.name: find_collector_tools
tools.description: Find TDS collecting tools and guides by task. Returns canonical links, supported languages, inputs and which functions MCP can actually call. Browser-only collection records are never read.

language.description: Interface language; some browser-only tools are available only in EN/DE.

tools.name: get_collecting_guide
tools.description: Read a published guide for one of eight collectible brands with official source links, review date and limitations. Not current stock, resale valuation or authentication.

language.description: Interface language; some browser-only tools are available only in EN/DE.

tools.name: plan_display_fit
tools.description: Calculate a uniform single-layer rectangular layout for toy footprints inside a display case. All dimensions use the same unit. Tests 90-degree rotation when allowed; not 3D packing or a safety/load certification.

gap.description: Space between adjacent items; same unit as all dimensions.

tools.name: compare_blind_box_budget
tools.description: Compare a capped independent blind-box budget with a user-supplied all-in confirmed-figure quote. Returns success and failure chances, maximum spend and expected spend when stopping at the first target. One currency, costs rounded to cents; not a purchase recommendation or price lookup.

tools.name: estimate_collection_progress
tools.description: Estimate new distinct regular styles, repeated regular draws and secret draws from independent boxes. Assumes equally likely regular styles after combined secret probability is removed. Owned means distinct regular styles from this exact series. Not sealed-case allocation or completion probability.

tools.name: search_collection_series
tools.description: Search the source-linked SMISKI and Sonny Angel catalog by series or figure name. Returns candidate series IDs, verified named styles, source URLs and per-series check dates directly. Catalog coverage can omit secret or discontinued figures; choose the exact series before comparing a collection.

language.description: Interface language; some browser-only tools are available only in EN/DE.

tools.name: prepare_collection_checklist
tools.description: Compare user-supplied distinct owned names with one verified series. Returns owned, not-marked-owned, explicit wanted names, unmatched inputs and a copyable Markdown checklist. Does not assume missing means wanted, infer quantities or trade intent, certify a complete set, or access browser storage. Use exact names from search_collection_series. Supplied lists are processed remotely but not saved by the tool.

owned.description: Exact figure names from the selected series. Distinct styles only; repeated input names do not establish owned quantities or trade offers.

wanted.description: Only figures the user explicitly wants. Omit or pass [] when not specified; unowned figures are never added automatically.

language.description: Interface language; some browser-only tools are available only in EN/DE.

tools.name: prepare_swap_event_card
tools.description: Prepare a user-supplied collector event template or personal preparation card, with explicit wanted/offered names, source matches, Markdown and a reviewable share link. Supports participant swaps, store-only swaps or display-only rules. Does not verify the organizer, event, ownership, matches or trades. The link contains readable user-supplied data: anyone holding it can read, edit or forward it. Review before sharing; expired cards are read-only. No browser storage access or automatic publication.

eventDate.description: Calendar date YYYY-MM-DD as supplied for the event; no attendance or timing verification.

rulesUrl.description: Optional user-supplied HTTPS rules link; not fetched or verified.

wanted.description: Explicit names only, preferably Series title / figure name. Unknown names remain unresolved; no inferred trade intent.

offered.description: Only items explicitly offered; prohibited in display-only mode. Repeated names do not establish quantities.

language.description: Interface language; some browser-only tools are available only in EN/DE.
